dispatches.html:
FLRSGLOBAL
FROM THE STUDIO OF FREDDIE L. RANKIN II
The Pleasure Dispatch
No. 000 · 2026-08-01 · Welcome to The Pleasure Dispatch
01 — A REFLECTION

Welcome to the first dispatch.

This is a place for notes from the studio, conversations around pleasure, images in progress, and the things I’m thinking about along the way. Less polished statement, more open notebook.

I’m interested in what sustains us, what we return to, and what happens when we start paying closer attention to those things.

Thanks for being here.

An offering of what has held my attention.
06 — A QUESTION
What has given you pleasure lately?
Pleasure is the desire to return.
THE PLEASURE DISPATCH · BY FLRSGLOBAL
